name: Binance
one_liner: Global crypto exchange (binance.com) with spot, futures, margin, wallet and earn REST/WebSocket/FIX APIs.
auth_notes: Public endpoints need no key. SIGNED endpoints need X-MBX-APIKEY header plus signature from HMAC, RSA or Ed25519 keys (Ed25519 recommended).
access_notes: API keys are created in the Binance account; a Binance account is required. Official key-creation and regional/KYC rules not verified because the help page and developer portal returned no text. Binance.US is a separate entity with its own API.

buildability.rationale: Documented broad API with self-created signed-request keys and a Spot Testnet. Caveats: trading/money-moving scope, IP-based rate limits and bans, region restrictions and KYC unverified, signature handling is non-standard.

needs_human_reason: Regional availability, KYC requirement for API keys, and official MCP status could not be verified from official pages that loaded.
